plataforma.exportLeeme:
Vive ADN export (format viveadn-exportacion-2)

manifest.json  Figures for each table (rows, columns with their type, content fingerprint), load order and omitted columns.
datos.json     All the church data as JSON.
csv/           One CSV per table: UTF-8 without BOM, comma separator, CRLF line endings. An empty unquoted field is NULL; an empty string is written in quotes.

For security, secrets are not exported (QR and invitation tokens, IP fingerprints). Login accounts are not included: people must be invited again.
Caution: if you open a CSV in a spreadsheet, a cell starting with = + - or @ may be read as a formula.
